tagline: Read together, whatever edition you hold.

home.emptyBody: Creating and joining clubs comes in a later step. For now you're signed in, and that's what this step is for.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back.
signIn.accountDeleted: Your account was deleted. Thank you for reading with us.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Join a club, log your page, leave notes for the others.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.nameHint: Shown to the people in your clubs.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signup: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.unverified: Confirm your email first. We sent a new link to {{email}}.
checkEmail.reset: If there's an account for {{email}}, we sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for 1 hour.
checkEmail.spam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: You've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once, for 1 hour. Ask for a new one.

confirmed.title: Email confirmed
confirmed.invalidBody: Confirmation links work once, for 24 hours. Sign in and we'll send you a new one.

errors.passwordCompromised: This password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.googleNotLinked: This email already has a Bookclub account that isn't confirmed yet. Confirm it with the link we emailed, then Google sign-in will work too.
errors.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again, or use your email and password.
errors.googleEmailMismatch: That Google account uses a different email address. You can only connect a Google account with the same address as your Bookclub account.
errors.googleTaken: That Google account is already connected to another Bookclub account.

server.degraded: Server reachable, but its database is not answering

account.title: Account
account.name: Your name
account.nameHint: Shown to the people in your clubs.
account.emailNote: Your sign-in address. It's never shown to other members.
account.passwordNotSet: Not set: you sign in with Google.
account.addPasswordSent: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to choose a password.
account.disconnectNeedsPassword: Add a password before disconnecting Google, so you can still sign in.
account.googleDisconnected: Google disconnected. Sign in with your password from now on.
account.devicesCount_one: You're signed in on this device only.
account.devicesCount_other: You're signed in on {{count}} devices, including this one.
account.signOutOthers: Sign out on all other devices
account.dataBody: Download everything Bookclub stores about you, as a JSON file.
account.dangerBody: Permanently delete your account and everything in it.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.body: This permanently deletes your profile, your sign-in methods and everything else stored with your account. It cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want to keep a copy.
deleteAccount.googleNote: You sign in with Google, so no password is needed.
deleteAccount.reauthBody: For your security, deleting an account without a password needs a sign-in from the last 24 hours. Sign out, sign in with Google again, then come back here.
